About Us

About Power Marine Partners

Power Marine Partners Inc. coordinates marine transactions from agreement to completion — the documentation, communication and follow-through between buyer, seller and broker.

Our role is to keep each step organised and on schedule, so every party knows what is needed, what is complete and what comes next.

  • One point of coordination for every transaction
  • Documentation prepared and tracked
  • Clear updates for all parties
